title: [PEPPOL] Add PEPPOL SE localization: Swedish organisation number for endpoints under scheme 0007
summary: A Swedish PEPPOL localization app normalizes Swedish organisation numbers in electronic addresses and legal entity identifiers to the correct 10-digit format when emitted under scheme 0007, following the PEPPOL BIS 3.0 standard.
key_points: New PEPPOL SE localization app with enum extension and party info provider for Swedish-specific formatting
Swedish organisation numbers stripped to 10 digits (from 14-digit VAT) when scheme 0007 is used, while preserving full VAT in tax scheme fields
New PEPPOL 3.0 Setup records default to SE formats; existing setups maintain their configuration
Comprehensive test coverage including unit tests through enum dispatch and end-to-end invoice export validation
W1 PEPPOL app unchanged; SE-specific behaviour only activates when SE formats are selected
